name: existing-app-improvement
description: Repository-scale improvement workflow for existing applications. Prevents broad requests from collapsing into tiny local edits.
guidelines: Map routes, templates/components, styles, scripts and tests before broad edits; understand shared shells and dependencies first.
For application-wide requests, explicitly account for each discovered user-facing surface rather than improving only the easiest page.
Prefer coherent shared-component and multi-file batches before expensive build/deploy cycles.
For visual work, render representative pages before editing and after editing at desktop and mobile widths when browser capability is available.
Use vision on screenshots when available; use DOM, overflow, console and network diagnostics as deterministic evidence regardless.
A passing test suite proves correctness, not improvement. Require a meaningful rendered/user-visible delta before declaring a broad improvement complete.
Preserve existing authorization, data integrity and workflow behavior while improving presentation and maintainability.
Add regression tests for behavior changed and verify relevant routes after shared-shell changes.
definition_of_done: The discovered route/surface set is covered, verified acceptable, or explicitly deferred with a reason.
Changed shared components and page-specific surfaces remain consistent across desktop and mobile.
Browser console/network diagnostics show no new critical failures on representative flows.
Before/after evidence shows material improvement for broad UI/UX requests when rendered inspection is available.
Relevant automated tests and deterministic verification pass.
